picture.source_comparison: Every native frame compared to its original fixed source crop and uniform contain transform; no frame above the 3/255 quarter-resolution gray MAE threshold. This is compression/transform tolerance, not pixel identity.

caption_review.scope: Independent model visual and measured encoded-frame review

audio.pace_scope: Approximately 2.3 words per spoken second in aggregate. Four short clauses were judged brisk but intelligible, without clipped syllables or masking; this is not a universal per-clause rate cap.

browser_playback.scope: Complete actual browser playback observed by the model; not human listening or user approval

truth_scope.environment: Lens Studio Preview simulated room, including actual Center mode
truth_scope.input: Visible scripted SIK hand input; commits and controls use actual native interaction paths.
truth_scope.opening: Moving the table clears the chair turn; the door remains a separate check.
truth_scope.real_size: A measured 1.5 by 2 metre indoor bedside patch at scale 1, showing 26 complete expanded chair footprints from a 49-pose path; not the whole room or automatic furniture registration.
truth_scope.feature_insert: The separate chair-width demonstration changes 66 to 71 cm. The continuous main explicitly uses the original chair.
truth_scope.companion: The QR transfers the model for fresh checks, not the earlier route certificate.
truth_scope.current_presentation: Later Undo visibility and first-use hint hold fixes were separately verified; captured product006 pixels remain unaltered.
